name_reason: Conforms to fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: domain=animate, descriptor=status_effect_overlay_flicker. Accurately reflects the body: it draws a 24x24 status-effect silhouette over each targeted char, then flickers the modified battle frame against an unmodified snapshot 5 times. No Ghidra address residue. 11 spell/item status-apply callers confirm the 'status effect applied' visual-feedback role.
purpose: Plays the 'status effect applied' battle overlay+flicker animation: blits a status silhouette over each in-window targeted char, then flickers the live back-buffer against a snapshot 5 times and restores the snapshot.
logic_summary: (1) Copy the 30-byte status-effect colour template @0x51F15 into a stack scratch (7 dwords + 1 word, byte-exact). (2) fd2_play_sfx_with_handle(handle,1,1) for the status SFX. (3) malloc(0x25680) and memmove a snapshot of data_fd2_large_game_state_buffer_ptr. (4) For each of target_count entries in char_idx_array: read runtime_char (stride 0x50) at that index; cull if its pos_x/pos_y falls outside the battle view window; else compute frame_idx = sprite_state[0]*0xC + chapter_ambient_palette_anim_idx (force +2 when that idx==3), resolve the sprite via portrait_sprite_cache + portrait_sprite_cache[frame_idx*4], and fd2_tile_blit_24x24_solid_color it onto the back-buffer at the tile dst, tinted by tmp_copy[status_kind]. (5) Flicker loop x5: blit snapshot, wait 1 BIOS tick, blit modified buffer, wait 1 BIOS tick. (6) Blit snapshot once more (leave clean frame), free the snapshot buffer. The free()+ADD ESP,4+RET epilogue @0x1C4BC is tail-jumped by fd2_animate_spell_overlay_blink.
signature: void __cdecl fd2_animate_status_effect_overlay_flicker(uint param_1, uint param_2, uint param_3, uint arg_stack_4)

params.name: param_1
params.semantics: Caster / owner index. Consumed only by the leading __CHK(0x54,...) stack-overflow check; never used by the function body (callers pass the caster index, e.g. fd2_cast_status_inflict_spell forwards its caster arg).
params.reason: Generic placeholder name flagged by the naming rule; callers pass the caster index and it is forwarded to __CHK. Rename recorded only (Stage 2 applies it across protos.h/call sites).

params.name: param_2
params.semantics: Status-effect kind / colour selector. Indexes the copied colour template tmp_copy[status_kind] to pick the silhouette tint colour passed to fd2_tile_blit_24x24_solid_color (loaded into EBP at 0x1C2EB, indexed at 0x1C34B).
params.reason: Generic placeholder; actual use is the colour-template index. src already documents it as status_kind. Rename recorded only.

params.name: param_3
params.semantics: Number of target entries to process; loop bound for the per-char overlay loop (CMP ESI,[ESP+0x44] at 0x1C360).
params.reason: Generic placeholder; actual use is the target-count loop bound. Rename recorded only.

params.name: arg_stack_4
params.semantics: Pointer to a byte array of runtime-char indices (the targets); byte-indexed by the loop counter at 0x1C36E to select each runtime_char.
params.reason: Address-style generic placeholder (arg_stack_4); actual use is a byte pointer to the target-index array. Rename recorded only.

returns.semantics: No return value; produces the on-screen status-effect overlay/flicker animation as a side effect.

notes: Disassembly confirms src is byte-exact: MOV ECX,0x7 + REP MOVSD + MOVSW = 30B template copy (matches memcpy(...,30)); runtime_char stride 0x50 (SHL2/ADD/SHL4 = idx*0x50); EBP=[ESP+0x40]=status_kind indexes tmp_copy; [ESP+0x44]=target_count loop bound; [ESP+0x48]=char_idx_array byte-indexed. param_1 only feeds __CHK. src comment (lines 18-35) and Ghidra plate are mutually consistent and accurate; neither needed editing. All 4 params get rename proposals (recorded only) to match documented semantics; function name kept.
